comment: The database release lines, and the only place they are written down.
hack/verify-kubernetes-support.go holds the table on
docs/site/src/content/docs/support/databases.md to this file, and builds the
matrix of the Added database lines workflow from it.
baseline names what every CI run proves: the images hack/e2e-kind.sh defaults
to, which the verifier holds to these rows.
added names a line that costs too much to run on every push. The workflow
runs each one on a schedule and before a release, over every supported
Kubernetes minor and every suite but the ones listed under leftOut. The state
is pending until a run is green on the line. Then it is supported, evidenceRun
names that run, and the line takes its row in the table. The bar for the table
does not change: the complete lifecycle, green on every supported minor.
A run on a pull request is only evidence if it is left to conclude: a push to
the pull request cancels it, and merging or closing the pull request cancels it
through cancel-closed-pull-request.yml. Wait for the verdict, then promote.
The release preflight reads evidenceRun line by line: its jobs for this line and
the jobs every line shares, on this commit's supported minors and suites, at a
commit that names this image. A re-pin or a new minor needs a new run.
The image tag has to name the major version, because the lifecycle holds both
PostgreSQL servers to it, baseline or added. imageCreated is the day Docker
reports for the digest on linux/amd64. The verifier refuses one under two weeks
old, and each job of an added line refuses a date that is not the image's own.
A suite can be left out only when the driver hands every one of its phases
another engine, because that suite cannot say anything about this line. A
suite that runs both engines stays: its PostgreSQL half is the reason to run
it, and the suite is the smallest unit the driver selects.

leftOut.reason: Its one phase is the versioned migration rows on MySQL. Its data-plane preparation starts PostgreSQL, and no row reads it.
